name: BSA C15 / B40
engine: 247 or 343 cc air-cooled OHV unit single, points
intro: BSA's unit singles of the 60s. Light and simple, with points ignition and a reputation for needing fresh oil often.

B: It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
